identity.name: Heritage Collection Chronograph Spring Drive GMT
identity.one_liner: The high-end Spring Drive chronograph GMT with a column wheel and vertical clutch — Grand Seiko's statement of horological independence.

provenance_events.description: Grand Seiko releases the SBGC249 with the in-house 9R96 Spring Drive chronograph, the brand's first column-wheel/vertical-clutch chronograph with quartz-regulated accuracy.

narrative.story: The 9R96 is the more premium of Grand Seiko's two chronograph movements: column wheel and vertical clutch, plus a 72-hour reserve, plus ±1 second/day accuracy. The SBGC249 wears larger than the 41mm dress pieces but is a coherent "sport-traveller" at 44.5mm with 100m water resistance.
narrative.collector_notes: The dial layout borrows from the SBGA413 Shunbun family — clean, with subtle texture in the seconds sub-dial.
